title: boolean operators

lines.code: if((value1 == 1) && (value2 == 2)) System.out.println("value1 is 1 AND value2 is 2");
lines.explanation:
Operator && is the logic AND, and is used to combine conditions. It evaluates to true only if 
both conditions are true.
If any or both conditions are false, the entire 
&&-condition is false.

lines.code: if((value1 == 1) || (value2 == 1)) System.out.println("value1 is 1 OR value2 is 1");
lines.explanation:
Operator || is the logic OR and is used to combine conditions. It evaluates to true if any 
or both conditions are true.
Only if both conditions are false, the entire ||-
condition is false.
